adjudication.rationale: In Jobs::PollFeed#execute, poll_feed runs only if `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? && SiteSetting.feed_polling_url.present? && SiteSetting.embed_by_username.present?`. In `spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb`, the examples "requires feed_polling_url" and "requires embed_by_username" only stub `feed_polling_url` or `embed_by_username` respectively, but do not stub `feed_polling_enabled?` to true. Since the default in the added `config/site_settings.yml` is `feed_polling_enabled: false`, these specs can pass without ever exercising the missing-url/missing-username branches (short-circuit on `feed_polling_enabled?`). That makes the tests potentially vacuous with respect to what their descriptions claim to verify.
